title: Review: entire project — mime-tree + smime-tree
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — P0 bugs are doc/stale-comment correctness issues. Real correctness bug: P-384 key produces wrong OID in sign(). Dead public API variant (EcdhEs) and non-exhaustive enums are the main pre-1.0 API design risks.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — Core logic is solid idiomatic Rust. Main idiom issues: error variants that lose source chain (CertChain/Other wrap String), dead extension-point trait methods, and the dead EcdhEs variant. No unsafe code. No gratuitous clones in hot paths. Iterator usage is clean.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: KARI decrypt path has no integration test with real ECDH fixtures (could have an encoding bug in EccCmsSharedInfo or SharedInfo DER that only manifests with a real ECDH impl). KeyUsage check in is_ca_cert — could be over-strict for real-world chains that omit it. Uncertainty driven by: KARI is new code with no end-to-end test. Would raise confidence if: an ECDH integration test (openssl or python cryptography) passing through encrypt+decrypt for a P-256/P-384 key pair was added.
